name: OSS_BALANCE_OBJECT_USAGES
description: Following table is used to capture balance object usage.

columns.name: BALANCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Field for capturing  balance object id.

columns.name: BALANCE_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Field tracks the balance object name.

columns.name: OBJECT_TREE_LEVEL
columns.description: Field tracks the object tree level.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Field tracks the parent object id.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Field tracks the parent object name.

columns.name: REF_KEY_ATTRIBUTE1_NAME
columns.description: Field tracks the first  reference key attribute name.

columns.name: REF_KEY_ATTRIBUTE2_NAME
columns.description: Field tracks the second  reference key attribute name.

columns.name: FOREIGN_KEY_COLUMN1
columns.description: Field tracks the first  reference key attribute column.

columns.name: FOREIGN_KEY_COLUMN2
columns.description: Field tracks the second  reference key attribute column.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
